metadata.note: Relayed variant of `safenet/announcement-without-relaying.json`: the same call into `SafenetGuard.announceTransaction(...)`, but with a native-currency refund attached. `gasToken` is the zero address, `gasPrice` is 1 gwei and `baseGas` is 50,000,000,000, so the Safe will pay `(gasUsed + baseGas) * min(gasPrice, tx.gasprice)`, i.e. about 50 ETH, to `refundReceiver`, an address with no prior interaction with the Safe. Per § 2.18 of the Safenet Charter the relaying parameters must be considered: a refund of this size is not a gas reimbursement but a transfer of the Safe's ether to an untrusted receiver. Note that the refund is paid in native currency, not through an ERC-20 `transfer`, and that it is paid whether or not the inner call succeeds.
